missing_critical_data.reason: The Q1 report provides only the direct-method cash-flow statement and does not disclose cash-flow supplemental reconciliation lines for fixed-asset depreciation, right-of-use asset depreciation, intangible amortization, or long-term prepaid expense amortization. 2025FY D&A is sourced but cannot replace 2026Q1 D&A.
missing_critical_data.required_for: L2 financial model and EV/EBITDA normalization
missing_critical_data.next_source_required: 2026 interim/annual cash-flow notes, management-provided latest-period D&A bridge, or a documented TTM/annualized model policy if source gate is relaxed

missing_critical_data.reason: Q1 balance sheet discloses non-current lease liabilities of 629,404,406.85 and one-year due non-current liabilities of 1,381,052,087.46, but does not separately identify the current lease-liability component. 2025YE current lease-liability reference of 75,428,257.68 cannot be carried forward without estimation.
missing_critical_data.required_for: net debt and enterprise value bridge
missing_critical_data.next_source_required: 2026 interim/annual lease-liability note with current and non-current split

missing_critical_data.reason: Q1 discloses attributable net profit, basic/diluted EPS, share capital, treasury-stock carrying amount, and shareholder data, but does not directly disclose diluted weighted-average shares or a fully diluted share-count bridge. EPS is rounded to two decimals, so net profit divided by diluted EPS is not an official precise share count.
missing_critical_data.next_source_required: latest directly disclosed diluted weighted-average share count or full dilution bridge; supporting values include share capital 1,190,432,569 and treasury shares 34,439,271 from the dividend implementation announcement

missing_critical_data.reason: Official filings show treasury shares and repurchased shares intended for equity incentive or employee stock ownership plans, but no latest official bridge from outstanding options/restricted stock/repurchases/convertibles to incremental dilution. Capital reserve 'unexercised share payment' relates to subsidiary Zhejiang Zhongning Silicon's allocated share-payment cost and is not itself a parent-company A-share dilution bridge.
missing_critical_data.next_source_required: latest equity incentive and repurchase/dilution schedule

method_gate.company_type: cyclical industrial / fluorochemical and new-energy-material manufacturing
method_gate.valuation_method_router_result: Do not default to DCF. Preferred later-stage methods, if data gates pass, are cycle-normalized PE/EV-EBITDA, historical-band context, and SOTP by fluorochemical/new-energy-material/electronic-chemical/battery activities. DCF is disabled for now because latest-period FCFF is negative, commodity/material pricing is cyclical, and required equity-bridge inputs remain incomplete.
method_gate.comps_status: blocked_until_same-source peer market and financial data are collected
